subtitle: Lean Launch — Compiled Resources & Performance Budgets
changes: Introduced Lean Launch delivery: reduced 25 stylesheet plus 26 deferred JavaScript requests to two CSS and two JavaScript bundles while preserving all original source files and their order.
Preserved all existing World of Warcraft studios, data formats, character tools, Battle.net verification, Cloudflare Worker and the current Assassin Dominion visual design.
Added a deterministic dependency-free Node 22 bundle maintenance tool that verifies byte-for-byte compiled asset parity with all 51 original sources.
Added a strict site asset request budget and browser startup timing logs to the existing desktop Chromium and mobile Chromium/WebKit GitHub Actions audit.
Kept the full suite of per-studio source tests and website-shell regressions with a versioned v4.7 release record for the existing Discord announcement pipeline.
Documented how future site or studio source edits should regenerate compiled assets without requiring end users to install Node or change Cloudflare.
Reduced repeated network request overhead, without claiming untested improvements to real-device speed, CPU time or Blizzard API latency.
